title: Roommate Coordination Tool — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Organizes shared chores, schedules, and responsibilities between roommates. The Roommate Coordination Tool organizes shared chores, schedules, and responsibilities. It splits chores fairly on a rotating schedule, tracks shared expenses, manages quiet hours and guest agreements, and keeps a shared calendar for the living space. Disputes get rarer when everything is written down and fair.
capabilities: Split chores on a fair rotating schedule
Track shared expenses and settle up
Manage quiet hours and guest agreements
Keep a shared living-space calendar
Log agreements so disputes stay rare
